verdict.rationale: LangGraph explicitly documents durable execution — persisting through failures, resuming exactly where left off, database-backed checkpointers (Postgres) for production, interrupts/Command for pause-resume, and production-ready deployment infrastructure for long-running stateful workflows. This directly matches the story of running long-lived agents durably across restarts/deploys. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of durability across actual process crashes/deploys, and more detail on native vs third-party durable-execution integrations (e.g., Temporal-style engines) beyond LangGraph's own checkpointer/store system.
